title: Te Mataaratanga o te Hunga e Mate Ana
intro: Kei te tata koe ki te tūtaki ki tētahi wairua kua whakamatautauria e te wehenga hohonu rawa atu, e mōhio ana ōna kanohi ki te reo o ngā roimata, engari kāore i ngaro te tumanako o tōna ngākau. I roto i tētahi kōrero mō te tinihanga, te hiahia, me te huihuinga anō, ka noho tēnei pononga rangatira a Allah hei tohu mō te manawanui mō ngā wā katoa. Nā wai i whakamanawanui ngā tau o te mamae huna, ā, i whakahokia mai anō te tirohanga me te harikoa i roto i tētahi wā poto?
clues: He poropiti ahau, ā, ko tōna ingoa i waiho hei tohu mō te manawanui i te aroaro o te mate nui.
I manaakitia ahau ki te tini o ngā tama, engari i tangohia tetahi i ahau e te hae o ētahi atu.
Nā te hohonu o tōku aroha ki taua mea ngaro, kua mā ōku kanohi i te pouri, heoi kāore au i amuamu engari ki a Allah anake.
I tonoa e au aku tama kia hoki ki te rapu i taku i ngaro ai me tōna tuakana, me te akiaki i a rāua kia kaua e ngoikore te tumanako.
I te taenga mai o te kaikawe i te rongo pai, ka taupokina tōku mata e te hāte, ā, kātahi ka mārama anō te ao.
E mōhiotia ana ahau ko Iharaira, ā, nō aku tama tekau mā rua ngā iwi tekau mā rua o tētahi iwi nui.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
